tools.name: audit_site
tools.description: Performs multi-vector automated compliance auditing on a target website URL. Checks SSL/HTTPS, Google Consent Mode v2 signals, prior consent enforcement under GDPR Art. 5(3), legal links, security headers, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, and EU AI Act disclosures.

tools.name: audit_accessibility
tools.description: Performs itemized WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility audit on a web domain. Inspects image alt attributes, semantic landmark roles, form control labels, document titles, language bindings, and contrast indicators.

tools.name: audit_ai_transparency
tools.description: Audits a website for EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689) transparency compliance. Detects conversational AI chatbots, synthetic media disclosures, automated decision-making notices, and AI crawler directives (GPTBot, ClaudeBot).

tools.name: configure_cookie_banner
tools.description: Configures and personalizes the cookie consent banner for a site. Controls layout, theme colors, Google Consent Mode v2 integration, and tracker auto-blocking rules.

tools.name: get_cookie_banner_script
tools.description: Generates the ready-to-paste HTML embed snippet or framework code (React, Next.js, WordPress) for the site's cookie consent banner with Google Consent Mode v2 auto-initialization.

tools.name: get_consent_banner_code
tools.description: Returns production-ready, zero-code consent banner snippet with Google Consent Mode v2 default denied parameters and dynamic unblocking listeners.

tools.name: configure_gtm_integration
tools.description: Configures Google Tag Manager (GTM) integration with Google Consent Mode v2. Sets up consent state defaults and dataLayer triggers for unblocked tracking upon user consent.

tools.name: get_gtm_container_setup
tools.description: Generates complete Google Tag Manager setup instructions, including `<head>` and `<body>` installation snippets, GTM trigger recipes, and Google Consent Mode v2 integration guide.

tools.name: scan_cookies
tools.description: Scans a domain and generates an itemized inventory of detected cookies and third-party tracking scripts, categorized by Necessary, Analytics, Marketing, and Preferences.

tools.name: generate_documents
tools.description: Generates tailored legal document suites (Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, Cookie Policy, EULA, Acceptable Use, Disclaimer, Return Policy, Accessibility Statement) assembled from modular statutory clauses.

tools.name: generate_docs_questionnaire
tools.description: Generates tailored legal document suites using structured questionnaire answers.

tools.name: generate_dpa
tools.description: Generates a comprehensive GDPR Article 28 Data Processing Addendum (DPA) contract between Data Controller and Data Processor, complete with sub-processor listings and standard contractual clauses.

tools.name: verify_compliance
tools.description: Issues a real-time cryptographic compliance verification audit for a website. Validates live consent state, privacy disclosures, and returns a verified SVG trust badge snippet.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: Lists all monitored websites with pagination support, compliance grades, banner statuses, and document counts.

tools.name: get_site
tools.description: Retrieves complete configuration, compliance metrics, active legal documents, cookie banner settings, and embed snippets for a specific site.

tools.name: add_site
tools.description: Adds and provisions a new website in the Paperloo compliance monitoring registry. Initializes compliance grading, generates script embed tags, and provisions consent defaults.

tools.name: delete_site
tools.description: Deletes a monitored website property and cleans up all associated consent banners, audit records, and cached legal policies.

tools.name: get_questionnaire_schema
tools.description: Returns the standardized legal compliance questionnaire schema.

tools.name: export_documents
tools.description: Exports generated legal compliance documents in Markdown, HTML, or structured JSON formats.
